description:
In-memory range and multirange types for .NET 11, mirroring PostgreSQL's six built-in range domains (int4range, int8range, numrange, daterange, tsrange, tstzrange) plus TimeRange over TimeOnly — the time-of-day range PostgreSQL users conventionally add as CREATE TYPE timerange AS RANGE (subtype = time), and Float64Range and Float32Range over finite double and float (the custom float8range and float4range). Each type is a discriminated union of five sealed variants (Finite, UnboundedStart, UnboundedEnd, EmptyRange, Infinity) with invalid states unrepresentable at compile time.

Includes the full PostgreSQL interval algebra — Contains, Overlaps, IsAdjacentTo, Intersect, Union, Except, Complement, Merge (range_merge), bound accessors (lower/upper/lower_inc/upper_inc), the RangeAgg/RangeIntersectAgg aggregates, Gap/Gaps, Shift/Expand, Split, the Month/Quarter/Year/IsoWeek calendar factories and IComparable in PostgreSQL's range order — plus RangeSet<TRange, T> as an immutable, always-normalized multirange with the complete multirange operator matrix.

v6 adds value sets: immutable, canonical (deduplicated, sorted, null-free) sets of scalar values whose PostgreSQL storage shape is a native array — StringSet (text[]), GuidSet (uuid[]), Int16Set/Int32Set/Int64Set, DecimalSet, Float64Set (double precision[]), Float32Set (real[]), DateSet, TimeSet, DateTimeSet, DateTimeOffsetSet — plus a validated-wrapper arity for every one of them (StringSet<T>, GuidSet<T>, Int16Set<T>, Int32Set<T>, Int64Set<T>, DecimalSet<T>, Float64Set<T>, Float32Set<T>, DateSet<T>, TimeSet<T>, DateTimeSet<T>, DateTimeOffsetSet<T>) for Vogen/Metalama/StronglyTypedId-style domain values, constrained only on BCL interfaces. Membership algebra (Contains, Overlaps, IsSubsetOf, IsSupersetOf, Union), PostgreSQL array literals, and collection expressions included.

All types implement IParsable<T> and IFormattable using PostgreSQL literal syntax, and ship with System.Text.Json converters for direct use in ASP.NET Core APIs. No database dependency.
releaseNotes:
The first preview of the 11 line: the same public API as 10.4.0, on .NET 11. The 10.x line stays on .NET 10.

Breaking

- Targets net11.0 and needs the .NET 11 runtime, one target framework per line.
- Ranges: RangeAgg() and RangeIntersectAgg() skip a null range or set, as range_agg and range_intersect_agg skip a NULL row. With a null after another range, RangeIntersectAgg() returned empty, or threw after (,), and RangeAgg() threw unless an input was (,) (Migration (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/migration.md#check-rangeagg-and-rangeintersectagg-over-null-ranges)).
- Ranges: RangeSet.From, a collection expression and RangeSet.Create throw ArgumentException for a null range, where they built a set holding null, whose IsEmpty() was false. Union and Except called on a null range throw too (Migration (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/migration.md#keep-null-out-of-a-range-set)).
- Ranges: a predicate called on a null range, or given a null range or set, returns false, as a query does over a NULL column. Contains(Empty), IsContainedBy((,)) and (,).Contains(null) returned true, and Contains(T) and a null set operand threw (Migration (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/migration.md#check-predicates-over-a-null-range-or-a-null-column)).

Changed

- Docs: each package's Project website link on NuGet opens the documentation site (https://caffeinatedcoder.github.io/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/), and its README links the site and the walkthrough (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/walkthrough.md).
- Packaging: a package's release notes on nuget.org and in Visual Studio are its version's section of its changelog, in plain text, ending with a link to the changelog at the version's tag, where they were a link to the latest changelog (Changelog (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)).

Fixed

- Docs: What runs where (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/efcore.md#what-runs-where), the READMEs and the XML docs give each in-memory operation's real reason. Shift and Expand keep a bound at infinity, so that reason was stale. Length, Values, Split, the bridge conversions, Clamp, Intersect and Except would take composed SQL, not a missing operator. In-memory operations run in the final Select only.
- Value sets: every set type implements IFormattable itself, so ToString() and formatting no longer run the interface's default, whose shared-generic stub traps under Native AOT with ILCompiler 11 RC2 (Native AOT (https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/main/docs/serialization.md#native-aot)).

Full changelog: https://github.com/CaffeinatedCoder/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/blob/v11.0.0-preview.1/src/CodoMetis.ValueRanges/CHANGELOG.md
